en.t: Well, you are an honest and good student.

units.source_text: 你在背地里是否干了什么放荡不羁的事，我不知道。

en.t: I do not know whether you have done anything dissolute behind the scenes.

units.source_text: 但可怜的是，现在与过去不同，没有可供吃喝嫖赌的钱了吧。

en.t: But the pitiful thing is that, unlike in the past, you no longer have money for eating, drinking, womanizing, and gambling, do you?

units.source_text: 令尊和我，以及这里的住持，年轻时都干过相当恶劣的事哩。"

en.t: Your father and I, and the abbot here as well, all did some quite wicked things when we were young."
